repository.description: 🖼️  '벽전' 나만의 온라인 전시회를 열고 NFT 경매로 작품을 판매 해보세요!

issue.body:
## 📃 이슈 내용

리액트 v18 실험 버전 적용


## ✅ 체크 리스트

- [ ]  리액트 버전업

## 📌 레퍼런스

[리액트 버전업에 대한 질문](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/63213597/is-it-possible-to-use-experimental-version-of-react-while-using-create-react-app)

body: From the linked repo to this issue, the [document page](https://github.com/boostcampwm-2021/web14-salondesrefuses/blob/ee6be3c940a113e157c36c60d2dd4c92c3d3ca0b/client/pages/_document.tsx?_pjax=%23js-repo-pjax-container%2C%20div%5Bitemtype%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fschema.org%2FSoftwareSourceCode%22%5D%20main%2C%20%5Bdata-pjax-container%5D#L3) is extending from the default `Document` which has `getInitialProps` as its static method. Can you remove it to see if it works for you?
Can you just remove the `extends Document` or you make it a functional component returning the result from current `render` function?

Could you provide more details about the error trace?
I tried to run the client part of your project but didn't fully make it since it requires some server change.

I converted the document page to functional component and upgrade to latest next canary with react 18 beta, runs into 500 with error from emotion as well.

> err: TypeError: Cannot read property 'registered' of null

I wonder if it's the similar issue to #31678 since you're still using emotion as well. Currently emotion react adapter use some browser API like `document` while the browser bundled is consumed by the custom web runtime when `concurrentFeatures` is enabled.

Please check https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/31678#issuecomment-975447073 for details and we're still working on it for supporting it with node runtime.

I have exactly the same issue:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29461076/143786229-19278232-39da-4397-844d-ab459e22903e.png)
I have this error: Error: `getInitialProps` in Document component is not supported with `concurrentFeatures` enabled.

And then all the pages are 404 :(

Versions:
React & react-dom => 18.0-0-beta
 next 12.0.5-canary.10

@lveillard Looks like you're playing with server components from the build output.

`getInitialProps` is not supported by design, check the [next.js - react 18 doc](https://nextjs.org/docs/advanced-features/react-18#enable-react-server-components-alpha) here

Thanks! I think im not using getInitialProps at all, but im more a Product Manager than a dev and im new to Nextjs so im sure im doing something wrong.

I will keep playing with it and give feedback if i find issues when i understand it :)

I can reproduce this error by using the official example: ```sh npx create-next-app@latest -e custom-server-express custom-server ``` With the following settings: next.config.js - ```js module.exports = { experimental: { concurrentFeatures: true, }, } ``` dependencies - ``` "next": "12.0.5-canary.11", "react": "^18.0.0-beta-0cc724c77-20211125", "react-dom": "^18.0.0-beta-0cc724c77-20211125" ``` Then, execute `npm run dev`: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3382565/143997925-51150349-db92-42af-b787-3fc9f8d6efa0.png)

issue.title: relay-nextjs incompatible with new Next.js concurrentMode support
issue.body: Setting **concurrentFeatures: true** in **next.config.js** breaks relay-nextjs because of the use of **getInitialProps** in **_document.tsx** see also https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/31675 Will relay-nextjs support the latest and coming versions of Next.js with concurrentFeatures enabled?
